comparison.objective: Mix two test tubes by side-to-side wagging without vertical shaking, then return them to the rack; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasping near open tube mouths, controlled oscillatory motion, spill avoidance, and reinsertion versus precision counter-torque with driver and wrench.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both tubes mixed and racked while forbidding vertical shaking or excessive tilt; candidate requires a locked target angle retained over repeated gripper cycles.
comparison.reason: Repeated motion appears in both, but one grades safe mixing trajectories while the other grades retained mechanical calibration.
